description: Review items 1.4, 1.5, 2.4, 2.5 (backend). Replace the hand-tuned scheduler in app/storage/tutor/fsrs.py with an adapter over py-fsrs (`fsrs` 6.3.2 on PyPI, MIT, Python>=3.10, only dep typing-extensions) keeping the module's public API so tutor flashcards (TutorStore) and language vocabulary (LanguageStore) stay on the same scheduler. Verified bugs fixed by this: retrievability returned as retrievability(stability, 0) == 1.0 and elapsed measured from old due date; grades outside 0-3 fall into EASY; API defaults a missing grade to 2 and 500s on non-int; no learning steps; no review log; no undo. Also: app/storage/tutor/__init__.py re-exports SM-2 apply_review from srs.py (the review's 'srs.py not imported anywhere' is wrong - it is imported by the package __init__, but nothing uses that export). Independent of FEAT-001.
steps: Install: `python -m pip install "fsrs>=6.3,<7"`; add `"fsrs>=6.3,<7",` to [project].dependencies in pyproject.toml. Confirm the API before coding: `python -c "import inspect, fsrs; print(fsrs.__version__ if hasattr(fsrs,'__version__') else ''); print(inspect.signature(fsrs.Scheduler)); print(inspect.signature(fsrs.Card)); print(list(fsrs.State), list(fsrs.Rating)); print(inspect.signature(fsrs.Scheduler.review_card)); print(inspect.signature(fsrs.Scheduler.get_card_retrievability))"`. Expected: Rating Again=1..Easy=4; State Learning=1, Review=2, Relearning=3 (no New state); Card(card_id, state, step, stability, difficulty, due, last_review); datetimes must be UTC-aware.

Rewrite app/storage/tutor/fsrs.py (keep module path, docstring updated): module SCHEDULER = fsrs.Scheduler(desired_retention=0.9, learning_steps=(timedelta(minutes=1), timedelta(minutes=10)), relearning_steps=(timedelta(minutes=10),), maximum_interval=365, enable_fuzzing=False). Keep GRADE_AGAIN..GRADE_EASY = 0..3 and a ReviewResult dataclass with fields interval (whole days until due, 0 when intraday), ease (compat: clamp(1.3, 2.8, 2.8-(difficulty-1)*0.167)), reps, lapses, due (ISO UTC str), difficulty, stability, retrievability (float|None, R BEFORE this review), state ('learning'|'review'|'relearning'), step (int|None), last_review (ISO UTC). Functions: `validate_grade(grade) -> int` (accept only int, not bool, in {0,1,2,3}; else raise ValueError('invalid_grade')); `parse_when(value) -> datetime|None` (ISO datetime -> UTC; date-only 'YYYY-MM-DD' -> local midnight via datetime(y,m,d).astimezone() then .astimezone(timezone.utc)); `normalize_card(card) -> dict` (in-place, never deletes keys): if 'state' missing -> if reps==0 and lapses==0 and not last_review: state='new', step=0; else state='review', step=None, stability=clamp(float(stability or interval or 1), 0.1, 365), difficulty=clamp(float(difficulty or 5), 1, 10), last_review = old last_review (date -> local midnight UTC ISO) or (old due - max(1, interval) days), due = parse_when(old due) as ISO (same day kept); setdefault reps/lapses 0, due now for new cards; `to_fsrs(card) -> fsrs.Card` (new -> State.Learning step 0 stability/difficulty None last_review None; learning/relearning/review -> matching State with stored step/stability/difficulty/due/last_review); `apply_review(card, grade, now=None, today=None) -> ReviewResult` (validate_grade first; now defaults to datetime.now(timezone.utc); if only `today` (date) given, now = noon local of that date in UTC - keeps old call sites/tests working; compute retrievability_before = SCHEDULER.get_card_retrievability(fsrs_card, now) if last_review else None; new_card, _ = SCHEDULER.review_card(fsrs_card, Rating(grade+1), review_datetime=now); reps+1 always; lapses+1 only when state_before == 'review' and grade == 0; interval = max(0, (new_card.due - now).days)); `is_due(card, now=None, today=None) -> bool` (normalize a copy; new -> True; learning/relearning -> parse_when(due) <= now; review -> local date of due <= today; date-only legacy strings keep `due <= str(today)`); `retrievability(stability, days_elapsed) -> float` using the FSRS-6 power curve with the scheduler's decay (R = (1 + factor*t/S)^decay, factor = 0.9**(1/decay) - 1, decay = -parameters[20]); 0.0 if stability <= 0; `sort_due(cards)` (learning/relearning by due first, then review by due, then new in stored order); `next_learning_due(cards, now)` -> earliest future due ISO among learning/relearning cards whose due is today (local), else None; `SCHEDULING_KEYS = ('state','step','stability','difficulty','due','last_review','interval','ease','reps','lapses','retrievability')`.
Delete app/storage/tutor/srs.py; change app/storage/tutor/__init__.py to re-export GRADE_* and apply_review from app.storage.tutor.fsrs.

New app/storage/tutor/review_log.py: class ReviewLog(path) with a threading.Lock; `append(entry: dict) -> dict` (adds id 'rev-<uuid8>' / 'undo-<uuid8>' if missing; writes one JSON line, ensure_ascii=False, UTF-8, creating parent dir; never rewrites existing lines); `entries() -> list[dict]` (tolerates a missing file and skips corrupt lines); `active_reviews() -> list[dict]` (type 'review' entries whose id is not the target of any 'undo' entry); `last_active_review()`. File: <store storage_dir>/review_log.jsonl.

app/storage/tutor_store.py and app/storage/language_store.py: replace _normalize_card/_normalize_vocab defaults with fsrs.normalize_card (language keeps its cefr/category setdefaults); new cards created with state 'new', stability None, difficulty None, due = now ISO UTC. In review_flashcard / review_vocabulary: call validate_grade first (let ValueError propagate), take `before = snapshot(card)` (exact raw scheduling keys present + list of absent keys, deep-copied) BEFORE normalizing, normalize, apply_review(card, grade), write result fields (interval, ease, reps, lapses, due, difficulty, stability, retrievability, state, step, last_review), take `after = snapshot(card)`, save, then append the log entry {type:'review', deck:'tutor'|'language', card_id, grade, rating: grade+1, reviewed_at, local_date: str(date.today()), state_before, state_after, retrievability_before, interval_days, xp: <amount awarded, language 10 now (existing add_xp(XP_VOCAB_REVIEW)), tutor 0 until FEAT-003>, before, after}; return the card dict plus 'review_id'. get_due_* return sort_due(...) of due cards. Add `undo_last_review() -> dict`: entry = log.last_active_review(); none -> {'ok': False, 'error': 'nothing_to_undo'}; card missing -> {'ok': False, 'error': 'card_not_found'}; snapshot(card) != entry['after'] -> {'ok': False, 'error': 'stale'}; else restore entry['before'] exactly (set present keys, pop absent ones), revoke XP (language: subtract entry['xp'] from stats total_xp/daily_xp, floor 0 - FEAT-003 replaces this with the XP service), save, append {type:'undo', target: entry['id'], undone_at}, return {'ok': True, 'card': dict(card), 'undone_review_id': entry['id']}. Add `self.review_log = ReviewLog(self.storage_dir / 'review_log.jsonl')` in __init__.

app/ui/panel/api/tutor.py and language.py: parse grade strictly - payload grade must be an int in 0..3 (reject missing, bool, str, float) -> 400 {'ok': False, 'error': 'invalid_grade'}; also catch ValueError from the store -> 400. Add POST /api/tutor/flashcards/undo and POST /api/language/vocabulary/undo to the path sets: ok -> 200 {ok, card, undone_review_id}; nothing_to_undo -> 404; card_not_found/stale -> 409. GET .../flashcards/due and .../vocabulary/due responses add 'next_due_at': next_learning_due(all cards, now).

Rewrite tests/test_fsrs.py for real FSRS semantics (the current file encodes hand-tuned behavior such as 'Again on a new card -> due tomorrow, lapses=1', which is not FSRS). Use fixed UTC `now` datetimes. Cover: validate_grade rejects 5, -1, True, '2', None, 2.0 and apply_review raises ValueError; new card + Good -> state learning, due ~10 min later, interval 0; second Good -> state review, interval >= 1; Again on new -> learning step 0 due ~1 min, lapses 0; review card + Again -> relearning, lapses+1, due ~10 min; 30 consecutive Easy reviews (advancing now to each due) -> every interval <= 365; retrievability_before is None for a new card and strictly between 0 and 1 for a reviewed card reviewed days later, and is not 1.0; retrievability() in [0,1], == 1 at t=0, decreasing in t, 0.0 for stability 0; migration: legacy SM-2 card {ease 2.5, interval 3, reps 2, lapses 0, due 'YYYY-MM-DD'} normalizes to state review with the same local due day, keeps 'ease'/'interval' keys, and reviews without error; old FSRS-lite card {difficulty 5, stability 1.0, reps 0, lapses 0, due today} -> state new; legacy stability 5000 clamped to 365; is_due for date-only past/today/future strings (existing three tests keep passing), learning card due in 5 min not due now but due at now+6min, review card due later today counts as due today.

New tests/test_review_undo.py (TutorStore and LanguageStore on tmp_path): review writes exactly one log line with before/after; undo restores the exact pre-review dict (including keys that were absent, e.g. a legacy card without 'state'); undo twice undoes the two latest reviews newest-first; undo with nothing -> nothing_to_undo; modifying the card after review -> stale; language XP returns to the pre-review total after undo; the log file only ever grows (line count before/after undo, earlier lines unchanged).

Update tests/test_tutor_store.py::test_add_and_review_flashcard (review with grade 3 Easy and assert state 'review' and due date > today; separately grade 2 Good -> state 'learning' and still due later today) and tests/test_language_store.py::test_reviewed_card_not_immediately_due (Easy graduates -> not due; add a case Good -> learning, not due right now). Extend tests/test_panel_tutor_api.py: invalid grade (5, missing, 'x') -> 400 invalid_grade; review then POST /api/tutor/flashcards/undo -> 200 and card reps back to 0; second undo -> 404. In its fixture pass `language_store=LanguageStore(storage_dir=str(tmp_path / 'language'))` to AgentOrchestrator so the test no longer touches the real data/language.

Commits (stage by name): `feat(estudos): agenda FSRS real (py-fsrs) com learning steps e migração de cards` (pyproject, fsrs.py, __init__, srs.py deletion, store normalize/review changes, API grade validation, test_fsrs/test_tutor_store/test_language_store) then `feat(estudos): log imutável de revisões e desfazer última revisão` (review_log.py, undo, endpoints, test_review_undo, test_panel_tutor_api).
acceptance_criteria: Invalid grades are rejected by apply_review (ValueError) and by both review APIs (400 invalid_grade).
New cards go through 1 min / 10 min learning steps; lapses go to relearning (10 min); no interval exceeds 365 days.
ReviewResult.retrievability is the pre-review value (None for new cards, never the constant 1.0).
Existing stored cards (SM-2 and FSRS-lite shapes) load, keep their due day and legacy keys, and review without errors.
Every review appends an immutable review_log.jsonl entry; undo restores the exact prior card state and appends an undo entry.
Tutor and language decks use the same scheduler module.
verification: python -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --tb=short tests/test_fsrs.py tests/test_review_undo.py tests/test_tutor_store.py tests/test_language_store.py tests/test_panel_tutor_api.py tests/test_tools_smoke.py
findings: Commits on main: d3a7304 (scheduler/migration/grade validation) and de29883 (review log + undo). Verification: 97 passed. fsrs 6.3.2 installed (no __version__ attr). Confirmed API: Scheduler(parameters=21 floats, desired_retention, learning_steps, relearning_steps, maximum_interval, enable_fuzzing); Card(card_id, state, step, stability, difficulty, due, last_review) - card_id=None makes Card sleep 1ms, so the adapter passes card_id=1; State Learning=1/Review=2/Relearning=3; Rating Again=1..Easy=4; review_card(card, rating, review_datetime, review_duration) -> (Card, ReviewLog) and raises ValueError unless review_datetime.tzinfo is exactly timezone.utc; get_card_retrievability(card, current_datetime) returns 0 when last_review/stability is None and uses WHOLE elapsed days ((now-last_review).days), so R is 1.0 for a card reviewed earlier the same day; scheduler exposes _DECAY=-parameters[20] and _FACTOR. Module app/storage/tutor/fsrs.py exports: GRADE_*, MAX_INTERVAL_DAYS=365, SCHEDULER, SCHEDULING_KEYS, ReviewResult, validate_grade, parse_when, normalize_card, new_card_fields() (state 'new', step 0, stability/difficulty None, reps/lapses 0, due now ISO UTC), review_fields(result) (dict written back to the card), to_fsrs, apply_review(card, grade, now=None, today=None), is_due(card, now=None, today=None), retrievability, sort_due, next_learning_due(cards, now=None). Card dict fields after review: state 'new'|'learning'|'review'|'relearning', step int|None, stability float, difficulty float, due ISO UTC datetime string (e.g. '2026-06-01T15:10:00+00:00'; legacy cards may still hold 'YYYY-MM-DD' until reviewed), last_review ISO UTC, interval int days (0 = later today), ease, reps, lapses, retrievability float|None (pre-review). New cards have stability/difficulty = null in JSON: frontend types (VocabCard.stability?: number in frontend/src/types.ts) must accept null. Snapshot/restore helpers live in app/storage/tutor/review_log.py (snapshot(card) -> {'values': {...}, 'absent': [...]}, restore(card, snap)) plus ReviewLog(path).append/entries/active_reviews/last_active_review; file <storage_dir>/review_log.jsonl. Review log entry: {id 'rev-xxxxxxxx', type 'review', deck 'tutor'|'language', card_id, grade, rating, reviewed_at (ISO UTC), local_date 'YYYY-MM-DD', state_before, state_after, retrievability_before, interval_days, xp (tutor 0, language 10), before, after}; undo entry {id 'undo-xxxxxxxx', type 'undo', target <review id>, undone_at}. FEAT-003 (XP service) should: set the tutor entry 'xp' to the awarded amount and replace the manual total_xp/daily_xp subtraction in LanguageStore.undo_last_review; streak changes and stats.vocab_mastered are NOT reverted by undo. Store methods: review_flashcard/review_vocabulary(card_id, grade) raise ValueError('invalid_grade') before lookup, return card dict + 'review_id' or None; undo_last_review() -> {'ok': True, 'card': {...}, 'undone_review_id'} or {'ok': False, 'error': 'nothing_to_undo'|'card_not_found'|'stale'}. HTTP (FEAT-004): POST /api/tutor/flashcards/review and /api/language/vocabulary/review -> 200 {ok, card(with review_id)} | 400 {ok:false,error:'invalid_grade'} (grade must be JSON int 0..3; missing/bool/str/float rejected) | 404 card_not_found. POST /api/tutor/flashcards/undo and /api/language/vocabulary/undo (body ignored) -> 200 {ok, card, undone_review_id} | 404 nothing_to_undo | 409 card_not_found/stale. GET /api/tutor/flashcards/due and /api/language/vocabulary/due -> {cards (sorted: learning/relearning by due, review by due, then new), next_due_at: ISO UTC of the earliest learning/relearning card due later today, or null}. Undo is per deck (each store has its own log), newest-first. A Good on a new card keeps it in 'learning' due in 10 min (not in the due list until then), Again -> due in 1 min, Easy graduates. srs.py deleted; app/storage/tutor/__init__.py re-exports from fsrs. test_panel_tutor_api fixture now uses a tmp LanguageStore (EnemStore still default-constructed by AgentOrchestrator, pre-existing). A git auto-gc 'Unlink of file .git/objects/pack/...idx failed' prompt appeared after the 2nd commit (a pack file is locked by another process); the commit itself succeeded. INTEGRATION CHECK (convergence fixer, iteration 1, no review.json, HEAD 514549c): python -B -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider --tb=short <the 14 files of context.json test_command> -> exit 1, 268 passed, 2 failed (only the known pre-existing tests/test_tool_catalog.py personal_records failures, out of scope); node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json exit 0; npm run build exit 0; Vite on 127.0.0.1:5174 (Start-Process, stopped afterwards) + node tests/study.smoke.cjs exit 0 with 8 PASS lines and the 5 screenshots refreshed; node tests/broken-text.cjs exit 0; git status --short mobile_app empty; data/study absent before and after pytest. Manual seam review found no mismatches: /api/study/dashboard and /api/study/stats vs StudyDashboardData/StudyStatsData; due (cards+next_due_at), review, undo ({ok,card,undone_review_id}, 404/409), vocabulary list (.cards), delete, shadowing and conversation endpoints vs useStudy/useLanguage; language dashboard stats keys (no frontend reads of the stale stats.* XP keys); one shared StudyXP instance for the orchestrator TutorStore/LanguageStore and api/dashboard.py TutorStore() (get_study_xp cache by resolved path). No code changes and no commit were needed.
